Tao

Year 2013

Little brother of the Gïotto, the Täo in-ear headphones are elegant and modern. Its woven cable matches all clothing styles. It is the ultimate fashion accessory.

  • Superior sound quality
  • Seamless fabric flat cable
  • Built-in microphone for calls
  • Remote control for line pickup and volume adjustment
  • 3 tip sizes to fit all ears
